origine_fr: 其 posé sur la terre 土. C'est le bas d'un mur : la base, la fondation. 其 donnait le son, mais il se lit qí, plus jī.
origine_en: 其 sitting on earth 土. It is the foot of a wall: the base, the foundation. 其 once gave the sound, but it is now read qí, not jī.

phrase.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén jīchǔ hěn hǎo.
phrase.fr: Il a de bonnes bases en chinois.
phrase.en: He has a solid grounding in Chinese.
